_comment: Single source for model assignment, in two tables. 'sessions' holds every session the tooling opens on a named model: the /plan and /release orchestrators it starts in a new session, the /shadow-plan working session, and the coordinator, which is a primary-mode agent persona only because it must carry its own deny-write permissions. A command typed inside a plan's worktree runs in that chat on its own model and reads no entry here. 'agents' holds the model of every stamped subagent in .opencode/agents/, which AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS/SUBAGENTS/gen_agents.py writes from the canonical bodies. Use '<provider>/<model>' and an optional variant name; delete variant when the model has none.
